pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavatā paṭikkhittaṃ suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpetunti thokaṃyeva odātaṃ ante ādiyitvā tatheva suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.3: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū thokaṃyeva odātaṃ ante ādiyitvā tatheva suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.5: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.6: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave thokaṃyeva odātaṃ ante ādiyitvā tatheva suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.9: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā thokaṃyeva odātaṃ ante ādiyitvā tatheva suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpessatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.10: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.11: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.12.1: navaṃ pana bhikkhunā santhataṃ kārayamānena dve bhāgā suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ ādātababā tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ catutthaṃ gocariyānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.13: anādā ce bhikkhu dve bhāge suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ catutthaṃ gocariyānaṃ navaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.8: dhārayitvā dve tulā suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ ādātabbā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.13: anādā ce bhikkhu dve bhāge suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ catutthaṃ gocariyānanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.14: anādiyitvā tulaṃ odātānaṃ tulaṃ gocariyānaṃ navaṃ santhataṃ karoti vā kārāpeti vā payoge dukkaṭaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.16: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.19: idaṃ me bhante santhataṃ anādiyitvā tulaṃ odātānaṃ tulaṃ gocariyānaṃ kārāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.24.1: attanā vippakataṃ attanā pariyosāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.25: attanā vippakataṃ parehi pariyosāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.26: parehi vippakataṃ attanā pariyosāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.27: parehi vippakataṃ parehi pariyosāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.28: aññassatthāya karoti vā kārāpeti vā āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.29: aññena kataṃ paṭilabhitvā paribhuñjati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.31: tulaṃ odātānaṃ tulaṃ gocariyānaṃ ādiyitvā karoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.32: bahutaraṃ odātānaṃ bahutaraṃ gocariyānaṃ ādiyitvā karoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.33: suddhaṃ odātānaṃ suddhaṃ gocariyānaṃ ādiyitvā karoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.34: vitānaṃ vā bhummattharaṇaṃ vā sāṇipākāraṃ vā bhisiṃ vā bimbohanaṃ vā karoti
